text:
Maya Rao: Quick capture from today's onboarding calls — summarizing recurring pain points from 3 accounts. TL;DR: search latency spikes, token-cost surprises on long prompts, and customers asking for per-route billing visibility. Posting raw notes for prioritization.
Alex Chen: thanks Maya — can you list which accounts called out each item? helps triage urgency.
Maya Rao: Sure — short mapping below.
Maya Rao: - Polara Health: search latency when seq > 1024 (mostly during daily batch queries)
Maya Rao: - Meridian Ops: surprised by token burn in chat sessions with long system prompts
Maya Rao: - NovaRetail: asked for per-route billing + export so finance can map spend to features
Samir Patel: capturing this into the CS playbook triage board now. Question: are these feature requests or onboarding docs gaps?
Maya Rao: mix of both. Polara is infra/runtime issue (latency), Meridian is cost/config guidance + possible product tolerance for truncation or summarization, NovaRetail is a product request (billing export).
Jordan Lee: tagging @product and @eng — recommendation: small infra investigative spike for Polara, doc snippet for Meridian, and scoped product ticket for NovaRetail billing.
Alex Chen: proposed priority: Polara (P0 for onboarding success), NovaRetail billing (P1), Meridian docs (P2). Agree? :thinking_face:
Samir Patel: agree with prioritization. I'll add owners and ETA estimates.
Samir Patel: CS Bot: created triage card -> ID 4587, owners: @eng-runtime (investigate), @product-billing (scoped ticket), @docs (guidance note).
CS Bot: triage card 4587 created by Samir Patel — status: open — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4587
Maya Rao: adding quick note on customer impact/quote: "Search slows down every night batch; engineers are blocked from shipping the weekly report."
Jordan Lee: For Polara, can @eng-runtime run a short profile: capture p95 latency for seq lengths 512/1024/2048 and attachment of kernel selection logs. If we get p95 delta > 2x at 1024, escalate.
Alex Chen: I'll drop a sample command for profiling into the triage card. Example for eng-runtime: ```python
# run within inference debug harness
run_profile(model='redwood-2', seqs=[512,1024,2048], batch=8, collect_kernels=True)
```
Maya Rao: Thanks all. Next step: Samir to confirm owners + ETA by EOD tomorrow; Jordan to kick off runtime profiling; Alex to mock a billing export UI sketch for product.
Jordan Lee: noted, I'll start profiling in the morning and post p95 numbers here.
Alex Chen: mock attached to card 4587. feedback welcome.
Maya Rao: Great. If anyone hears similar asks in other accounts, ping this thread so we can aggregate. :pushpin:
thread_summary: Onboarding call notes mapped to triage: latency (infra), token-cost guidance (docs), per-route billing export (product). Card 4587 created and owners assigned.
